race.comment: ALIEN ANGEL (3) clearly on top. She's a progressive mare who won nicely here fresh having also been well backed on debut last time in. She'll need to take a step forward now to BM62 grade but this does look fairly winnable against a few that haven't won in a while. TAN TAT DELIGHT (6) is one of those. She's threatened this time in but hasn't won one, okay in a BM64 last time out at Sandown Hillside when beaten 2.25 lengths. She draws low and can take holding out. ATAEGINA (2) tackled a much stronger race at Flemington last time out and was well accounted for but the effort two back at Bendigo reads nicely for this and she should take beating. VIENNA VIXEN (1) was poor last time but had been coming along well prior in some good races and back to that form she should be right in the mix. GAME PLAN (4) is in the each way mix.
